guides.title: InstructGPT: How Human Feedback Shapes Model Responses

assets.alt: Three-stage training pipeline: human demonstrations train an SFT response model; ranked candidate responses train an RM; a policy generates new responses scored by the RM and is updated with PPO. Blue arrows indicate feedback used for training.
assets.rights: Ouyang et al., Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback, arXiv:2203.02155v1, Figure 2. The default arXiv nonexclusive distribution license does not grant republication rights; cited only for personal academic reading in a private repository.

assets.alt: Figure 1 plots human preference win rate against 175B SFT by parameter count. GPT, prompted GPT, SFT, PPO and PPO-ptx curves rise across training approaches; both PPO curves exceed GPT at each size. A dashed line marks 50%, with 95% confidence intervals.
assets.rights: Ouyang et al., Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback, arXiv:2203.02155v1, Figure 1. The default arXiv nonexclusive distribution license does not grant republication rights; cited only for personal academic reading in a private repository.

assets.alt: Figure 4 compares rates of correctly attempting a task, following explicit constraints, closed-domain hallucination and appropriate assistant language. PPO models do better on tasks and constraints and hallucinate less than GPT, though SFT's hallucination bar is lower; vertical scales differ.
assets.rights: Ouyang et al., Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback, arXiv:2203.02155v1, Figure 4. The default arXiv nonexclusive distribution license does not grant republication rights; cited only for personal academic reading in a private repository.

assets.alt: Figure 33 plots pretraining loss coefficient on a logarithmic horizontal axis. DROP and SQuADv2 F1 rise on the left, where dashed lines mark GPT baselines; validation reward falls sharply at very large coefficients on the right.
assets.rights: Ouyang et al., Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback, arXiv:2203.02155v1, Figure 33. The default arXiv nonexclusive distribution license does not grant republication rights; cited only for personal academic reading in a private repository.
